audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart gave Pantheon all seven rows while the content chart (and 54.65% Veigar win rate) says the lane flips at 6 — Veigar from level 6 through late. Three rows disagreed.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: his kill window is levels 1-5; from 6 a leveled cage punishes the Shield Vault dive and Veigar's scaling takes over.
audit.corrected: Full rows 4-6 aligned to content (Veigar) with matching whys.

audit.why: Spikes: Pantheon levels 1-3 all-in and 6 global roam; Veigar E-rank/first item then 2+ items. Content spikes[] already accurate. suspectNames flag on 'Phenomenal Evil stacks' is a false positive — the passive is Phenomenal Evil Power and the phrasing is standard.

audit.whatIsWrong: The three biggest interactions were absent: Aegis Assault is a channel your cage cancels, its frontal block eats a dumped combo, and his burst opens with a Shield Vault auto-reset. No cooldown digits anywhere.
audit.why: Kit flags: E channel/untargetable-from-front (22s), W dash+hardCC+autoReset (13s), R 180s. Your E 20s.
audit.corrected: All three folded into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d with real numbers.

edits.before: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault (Stun), denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Pantheon wins by opening Shield Vault's stun into empowered Comet Spear, then leaving with Grand Starfall to snowball the map.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 — the point-and-click stun that starts every all-in; step up only inside that window. - Aegis Assault is 22s and a channel: your cage's stun cancels it, and its frontal block dies to a flank. - Grand Starfall is 180s — from 6, ping every vanish.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: A stunned Pantheon cannot turn Aegis Assault to face you — the edge-stun is your one free window for W plus Q, take it every time.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Aegis Assault blocks all damage from the front — dumping your combo into the raised shield wastes it; hit from behind or wait.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: By 6 your leveled cage plus stacks turn every Shield Vault dive into a stun-and-burst death trap.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: First big AP item and a real cage: you out-range and out-damage the melee dive in extended fights.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: At full build infinite AP, the cage and execute R one-shot the squishy Pantheon on sight — teamfights are yours.

notes: Chart: full layer gave Pantheon all seven rows; content chart (Pantheon 0-3, Veigar 4-6) is kit-grounded and matches the 54.65% Veigar win rate — full rows 4-6 aligned to it (win[] already correct, sides edited alone with matching whys per the chart rule). Rows 0-3 agree on Pantheon and their content whys already explain it; the full whys for those rows remain generic Veigar templates but rewriting them was lower value than the three flips — recorded in sectionsMissing. suspectNames 'Phenomenal Evil' is a false positive (passive is Phenomenal Evil Power; 'Phenomenal Evil stacks' is correct usage). Whether Event Horizon's edge stun interrupts Shield Vault mid-dash is not confirmable from kit text — not asserted.
